description: This PHP class 'AccessEmployeeFileController' handles HTTP requests to access employee data in JSON format within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. It manages permissions, formats data for download, and constructs HTTP responses.

classes.name: AccessEmployeeFileController
classes.description: Controller class for handling employee data file access requests, providing JSON formatted employee data with permission checks and response handling.

methods.name: getDownloadFormat
methods.description: Returns an instance of JsonDownloadFormat, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getMaintenanceService
methods.description: Returns an instance of MaintenanceService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes the HTTP request to retrieve employee data, checks permissions, formats data, and constructs the HTTP response.
